title: A front-end extension: WEB_DIRECTORY and registerExtension

questions.q: With WEB_DIRECTORY = "./js", what is the URL of js/brighten.js in a pack folder my_pack?
questions.why: The folder is served at /extensions/<name>, so the name of the folder inside your pack isn't part of the URL.

questions.q: A style.css sits in your web folder. What happens to it?
options: It is applied to the page
It is served, but your code has to add it
It raises an error at startup
questions.answer: It is served, but your code has to add it
questions.why: The listing holds .js files only. The docs say other resources are reached by URL.

questions.q: You want to change what every Brighten node does on the page. Which hook?
questions.why: It runs once per node type, and gives you the class to patch.

questions.q: Why call the old onExecuted when you replace it?
options: To keep what other extensions added
questions.answer: To keep what other extensions added
questions.why: They patch the same prototype. The lab shows the first extension's code no longer running.

questions.q: Your pack raises an error when Python imports it. What happens to its JavaScript?
options: It loads and shows the error
questions.why: load_custom_node reads WEB_DIRECTORY after the import succeeds. The exception skips that.
